priority_items.title: FBC first Civic Centre sitting product: FWRM challenges immunity and RFMF civilian-control language

Asks review of immunity provisions; justiciable rights restrictions; RFMF remain under civilian authority with no constitutional provision interpreted as allowing military interference; quotas; NGO standing. Questions consultation timeframe. Parent left FBC with no Civic Centre item. No SO.129, no gazette, no extra-constitutional act. Parliamentary. Not FLASH.
